about: Rolex Paris Masters 2026, main draw Mon 2 – Sun 8 Nov, La Défense Arena (Paris time; CET from 25 Oct). Martino decided 1 Nov: the game starts from the SECOND round (R32 → F); the first round (R64, 24 matches, the 8 top seeds have a bye) is not scored and is kept in opening_round, so its losers show as out while squads are open. This replaces the 20 Oct decision (all six rounds), taken too late to launch before Monday's first ball. Every time is an early floor: pin each from the order of play the evening before.

rounds.note: 2nd round, DRAFT LOCK; the top 8 seeds' first match; floor Tue 3 Nov, pin from Monday evening's order of play
